subject: Fix macro redefinition problem in `fmacros.h` (#1704)
reason: The change only guards `#define _DEFAULT_SOURCE` with `#ifndef _DEFAULT_SOURCE` in src/fmacros.h to suppress a macro-redefinition compiler warning on Linux. _DEFAULT_SOURCE is defined in both builds either way, so the preprocessor environment and compiled behavior are identical; it is a build/warning fix with no runtime behavior change, so no scenario can distinguish the builds.
